tank_description: The HSTV-L is a lightly armoured and agile attacker. Capable of high sustained speeds, drifts and jumps, it has a highly opportunistic and scavenger like playstyle with high potential damage output which can be tough to counter.

strengths.title: Exceptional mobility and Speed
strengths.description: The HSTV-L has the highest top speed out of any tank in HEAT, making it great for rotating around the map to help your team or pressure an objective. The agent passive also compounds this, allowing the HSTV-L to drift and also jump from heights with little risk to itself.

strengths.title: Build Variety
strengths.description: The HSTV-L brings lots of options to the table. Being able to spec into a very aggressive assassin, or a fast support for those who want to help others instead. From Crowd Control to Scavenging, this tank has a playstyle for most.

strengths.title: Flexible Abilities
strengths.description: Both abilities on the HSTV-L can be used in different ways. From a simple burst in damage output to helping set up a fight for your team, or even to immobilise so you can disengage, there's little its toolkit cannot do.

weaknesses.title: Weak Survivability
weaknesses.description: The HSTV-L doesn't have a great HP pool to work with, combined with his low armour values. The HSTV-L can be shut down easily by players that are paying attention. In particular, HSTV-L drivers may find HE equipped tanks particularly challenging.

weaknesses.title: Clip Reload Mechanic
weaknesses.description: The HSTV-L has an unique mechanic that shortens the reload whilst boosting. Incentivising commanders to push the tank in its downtime. However, players that fail to manage this stamina pool will find themselves without an option for a quick escape if they need to leave quickly.

tank_summary: The HSTV-L is a lightly armoured but highly agile attacker, built around speed, mobility, and opportunism. Capable of maintaining high speeds, executing drifts, and traversing terrain with impressive jumps, it excels at exploiting openings and striking vulnerable targets. Its scavenger-like playstyle allows it to rapidly capitalize on weakened opponents and chaotic engagements, making it a difficult vehicle to predict and counter on the battlefield.

The vehicle performs best when played patiently, using its mobility to chip away at enemies while waiting for the ideal opportunity to commit. Once an opening appears, the HSTV-L can rapidly transition from harassment to aggression, using its grenade launcher to strip any defensive shielding and then overwhelming isolated targets. Few vehicles are completely safe when caught alone against a skilled HSTV-L commander.

Commanders must remain mindful however, the HSTV-L's armour is largely token protection, capable of deflecting only the occasional poorly aimed shot, and should never be relied upon to absorb damage. Combined with a relatively small hit point pool, every mistake is heavily punished. High-Explosive ammunition is particularly dangerous, as it can inflict significant damage. The situation becomes even worse if the vehicle is immobilised, as its mobility is its primary defensive tool. Once tracked the HSTV-L can be rapidly destroyed before it has an opportunity to repair.
